correctness.rationale: The dual has exactly all <=4-sets, connected five-sets and induced hexagons and no >=7-sets. Two connected 5-extensions of a disconnected 4-set force a unique C6; thus the one-step private collapses of all nonhexagonal five-trees and the six-stage rooted spanning-tree collapses of each hexagon are globally valid. The remaining complex is a 2-connected 3-complex with reduced Euler characteristic -[C(n-1,4)-c5+h6], proving a 3-sphere wedge integrally. Alexander duality plus the original complex full 2-skeleton for n>=10 gives a wedge of degree n-6 spheres. Reconstructed all local steps for eight exact graphs, and independent mod-two simplicial-chain calculations for five graph cases. Finite checks are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Resolves the first unclassified girth boundary of the universal ordinary five-cut wedge theorem, where hexagons cause missing codimension-one faces. Gives an exact uniform topology classification and an overlap-insensitive independent hexagon contribution, with a constructive dual collapse mechanism. Strictly extends the existing girth>=7 theorem and recovers individually studied Heawood/Pappus ranks without assuming any disjointness of hexagons. Not an arbitrary slice or routine numeric increment.
